assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons use provisional_boundaries.geojson (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough). All areas and ratios are recalculated from provisional geometry and must be recomputed when official polygons become available.
assumptions.impact: Metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm) are provisional; FAR remains unknown pending official control.

assumptions.statement: 18 building footprints are conceptual design proposals generated by the agent. Heights, FAR, and retain/renovate/demolish classifications require official property and control data.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints express design intent, not approved construction scale or demolition conclusions.

assumptions.statement: 10 road centerlines are conceptual mobility strategies. None represent official road redlines or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Road geometry supports mobility concept discussion only; professional traffic and engineering review required.

assumptions.statement: Annual event system, developer community operation, and international communication mechanisms are conceptual suggestions, not confirmed government arrangements.
assumptions.impact: All events and operations require organizer approval, safety review, and operational entity establishment.
